pages.title: More than an Arrow
pages.text: Manage an earned ranged artifact’s ammunition and special firing modes.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Cursed Bow fires three phantom arrows or two special-arrow shots. Wrath of the Desert makes three sandstorms. Void Assault fires howitzers; sneaking changes Wither Assault missiles to howitzers. Laser Gatling reloads from carried redstone. Hold Meat Shredder toward a target: it owns its hurt-frame
